_comment: DERIVED, minimal Garmin export fixture (§8.4) — NOT a copy of any real person's record.
Two synthetic source arrays with only the keys the adapter reads, values chosen to exercise
each requirement case. Sleep and activity are naturally different vintages in the real export
(no 2026 sleep score exists — OPEN-01/02); here they are co-authored per date only to drive
the 'both present' code path. `bmrKilocalories` is present ONLY so a test can prove the
UNAVAILABLE SLEEP (2024-01-11): the real export never emits `overallScore: null`. An unscored
night carries a present `sleepScores` object with feedback/insight and NO `overallScore` key.
Availability gates on `'overallScore' in sleepScores`, never on `!= null`.
No intra-file duplicate calendarDates — the real export has none (OPEN-26 closed). Last-write-
wins on re-ingest is the MetricStore upsert's job, not the adapter's.
